title: We turned Kenshi into a 24/7 live show with a custom camera director, 3D battle map, and chat commands
author: Designer_Pop_601
selftext:
We built Kenshi Live Show (@BeepIsTooStrong), a nonstop 24/7 interactive broadcast running inside Kenshi on the open-source MeitouClient engine.

An autonomous squad roams the wasteland around the clock, picks fights, banters with live voices and facial lip sync, and takes live missions directly from Twitch chat (`!go [town]`, `!fight`, `!steal`, `!bar`). We also built a custom camera director that frames fights and cuts between speakers, plus an hourly review card and a free 3D battle map mod (TimeLight Map v1.4.0) released on Nexus Mods.

Short clip of our hourly review & camera system in action: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/h2givF_KaXA

Watch live 24/7 on Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/beepistoostrong

Free 3D Map mod & dev log: https://beepistoostrong.com/mods.html
